answer: Each epoch a random beacon spot-checks agents: each must answer a live compute heartbeat within 60 seconds, solving a fresh puzzle no script can precompute. A vine only climbs where it is rooted, and a grove of walnut trees cannot be faked by cloning one leaf a thousand times. Each heartbeat costs 5 POA, so 1,000 fake identities cost 5,000 POA per epoch and earn nothing. An honest agent pays 5 POA once and keeps its full share of rewards.
